capabilities.wealth_summary: Al Ramz is a DFM-listed Dubai broker, market maker and asset manager with total assets of AED 1.85bn and H1 2026 profit of AED 35.8m. Its proprietary 'Digital Financial Mall' (Al Ramz app and webtrade.alramz.ae) offers UAE, regional and US equities, IPOs and, since H1 2026, US options, with TradingView integration, Etihad Guest miles rewards and an AI investment assistant called THOR. It had 22.6k registered platform users and AED 3.5bn traded through the platform in H1 2026. Asset management sits in ARAM Capital Partners (ADGM, FSRA Category 3C), which runs UAE public funds (Fortitude, Horizons, a money market fund) and ADGM funds, and offers discretionary and advisory mandates. AUM was AED 1.5bn at 30 Jun 2026. A Group Head of Wealth Management & Sales (ex-FAB Securities) leads HNW coverage. The company says it is building AI into operations, with a new CRM platform and enterprise data architecture (Aug 2026).

private_banking.detail: Not a bank. HNW coverage through a Group Head of Wealth Management & Sales and ARAM DPMs for 'high-value clients'.

Public equity portfolios returned 13.4% net in 2025 (company claim).
